notes:
Background: FlowPilot builds a VS Code extension used by distributed engineering teams (security-first fintech customers). They want streaming inline completions and a low-latency 'typeahead' experience (<60ms per token ideally) for local dev and remote pairing sessions.

Key asks heard on calls: 
- Streaming completion with token-level latency guarantees for inline suggestions.
- Model/version pinning per workspace (pin stable smaller model for free users, larger model for paid teams).
- Auth: SSO for enterprise installs + per-device API key fallback for individual devs.
- Rate limiting behavior: they need predictable throttling headers and quota enforcement (soft limits for dev, hard limits for org).
- Fallback strategy: automatic downgrade to a quantized/fast model when latency SLOs would be breached.
- Observability: token-cost per request exposed so they can gate premium features.

Customer nuance: CTO asked "can we stream partial completions with incremental commit so we can show inline ghost text without blocking editor responsiveness?" They care about KV/prefix caching to avoid repeating heavy context for snippets.

POC scope agreed: 2-week POC integrating Redwood hosted API with extension using streaming websocket + SDK (send delta edits, receive partial tokens). Goal: measure end-to-end median RTT and token cost per 1k completions.

Quote from PM: "If we can hit ~50ms median and stable billing signals, this is product-market fit for our pro tier."
